limits: Per-condition denominators only; paired conditions are not independent.

Per-layer Wilson intervals are primary. ALL_LAYERS pools independent but nonidentical fixed geometries: its Wilson interval is a descriptive approximation, not calibrated coverage or field false-fix risk.
Integer-correct shadow acceptance may still have biased baseline angle.
Unmodeled slip makes one shared integer vector incompatible across selection and future; kept separate.
No GLRT phase correction or candidate replacement; no navigation integration.

metric_definitions.mean_baseline_angle_rmse_deg: Original sealed SUMMARY field: arithmetic mean of each case future 3D baseline-angle RMSE over every scored primary, including rejected/unresolved and wrong-integer candidates. NOT fixed-solution accuracy.
metric_definitions.shadow_accepted_angle_subsets: Only SHADOW_ACCEPTED; split into correct integer, wrong integer, and unrepresentable selection+future shared-N model; reports arithmetic mean and maximum of per-case five-epoch RMSE, plus maximum individual epoch angle.
metric_definitions.mean_observation_model_exact: CSV flag is conditional on the generator per-epoch truth N. A missed slip may have this flag True but model_truth_representable=False: a single shared N cannot represent the full selection+future window.
metric_definitions.correct_integer: Equality to synthetic carrier integers does not rule out noninteger phase bias or biased baseline.
metric_definitions.not_accepted: Separate rejected_count from unresolved_count; no replacement, retry or longer horizon.
metric_definitions.calibration: Independent diagnostic split with all thresholds frozen beforehand, not parameter training.
metric_definitions.Wilson: Per-geometry n=16 heldout intervals are primary. ALL_LAYERS n=48 independent but heterogeneous geometries gives a descriptive approximate Wilson interval, not exact binomial coverage or field integrity.
metric_definitions.GLRT_reject_any: Conditional fault-free-null rejection only. Holm does not control physical mislocalization probability when a fault or wrong N is present.
